title: Standard Form of Hyperbola
text: The standard form of a hyperbola is $y = \frac{a}{x-p} + q$, where the vertical asymptote is at $x = p$ and the horizontal asymptote is at $y = q$.

title: Identify p and q
text:
Comparing $f(x) =  rac{3}{x-2} + 1$ with the standard form:

- $p = 2$ (vertical asymptote at $x = 2$)
- $q = 1$ (horizontal asymptote at $y = 1$)

title: Write the Asymptotes
text:
The vertical asymptote is $x = 2$ (where the denominator equals zero).

The horizontal asymptote is $y = 1$ (the value of $q$).

Write as: x=2 and y=1
